frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Anomalies and Cross-Sectional Pricing: cataloging the empirical cross-sectional anomalies (value, momentum, quality, low-volatility, size) at intuition level — what each anomaly captures, why it persists in equilibrium under the efficiently-inefficient framing, and how the anomalies fit into the multifactor pricing structure
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Anomalies and Cross-Sectional Pricing
